summary_1line: Arjuna devastates enemy forces and kills Srutayus; Duryodhana, panicking, accuses Drona of favoritism before Drona arms him with a protective enchanted armor.

image_candidates.scene_text: Arjuna stands on his chariot loosing arrows in torrents while a river of blood filled with fallen warriors and elephants flows across the battlefield.
Srutayus charges with a raised mace toward Arjuna and Krishna, only for Arjuna’s arrows to sever his arms and head mid‑battle.
Drona chants mantras and fastens a radiant golden armor onto Duryodhana as astonished warriors watch in the war camp.
